Description:
[b][size=5]Your just a step away from crocn' n' rockn'.[/size][/b]

A simple Fashion Sense mod that gives the farmer crocs! You'll need the fashion sense mod installed and just go to the slide that says shoes and your ready to go!
[b][size=3]
As of 04/16/24 there are three types: Baya, Croc(OG), Flower Crocs.
[/size][/b]All three options are color customizable!
This is based off of the FS templates provided.
